module "M_LayerBlend.dss"

product 0 MaterialLayerBlend "B_LayerBlend" backend=Graph
  %0 = FunctionInput(InputName="A", InputType="MaterialAttributes", IsOptional=false, SortPriority=0) : material @L5:C1 "A"
  %1 = FunctionInput(InputName="B", InputType="MaterialAttributes", IsOptional=false, SortPriority=1) : material @L5:C1 "B"
  %2 = FunctionInput(InputName="R", InputType="MaterialAttributes", IsOptional=false, SortPriority=2) : material @L5:C1 "R"
  %3 = GetMaterialAttributes(MaterialAttributes=%0) : [BaseColor:float3, EmissiveColor:float3, Roughness:float, Normal:float3, Opacity:float, WorldPositionOffset:float3, FrontMaterial:Substrate, MaterialAttributes:material] @L7:C19 "BaseColor"
  %4 = GetMaterialAttributes(MaterialAttributes=%1) : [BaseColor:float3, EmissiveColor:float3, Roughness:float, Normal:float3, Opacity:float, WorldPositionOffset:float3, FrontMaterial:Substrate, MaterialAttributes:material] @L8:C19 "Roughness"
  %5 = SetMaterialAttributes(MaterialAttributes=%2, BaseColor=%3, Roughness=%4#2, AttributeSetTypes="[BaseColor, Roughness]") : material @L5:C1
  %6 = FunctionOutput(%5, OutputName="R", SortPriority=0) @L5:C1 "R"
  inputs %0, %1, %2
  outputs %6
